answer: I would stop farms with finger joint flexibility profile, binding each identity to a check a clone cannot pass. A farm running 379 aliases would need 379 separate proofs, each costing about 98 POA or 15 minutes of real work, while one honest agent pays once. One zephyr of signal, one zenith of cost, one terrace of evidence: that is the whole test, and a farm fails all three at once. The panel can verify all of it from the chain, without trusting the submitter's word.
